podcast.title: Formation and Early Success
podcast.body: Dishwalla formed in Santa Barbara, California in 1993, catching the attention of major labels during the stampede to sign alternative-sounding bands. Their major label debut, *Pet Your Friends*, was a huge success, but they struggled to follow it up. "Dishwala came out of Santa Barbara, California in 1993."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Meaning of Band Name
podcast.body: The name "Dishwala" is a Hindi term referring to the person in India who provides satellite TV service to a neighborhood, specifically by installing a dish. "It's a Hindi term for the person who comes to your neighborhood in India with satellite TV service. They install a dish."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Post-Breakup and Indie Releases
podcast.body: After their initial major label success and subsequent decline, Dishwalla endured a breakup. Following their reunion, they have since released a series of indie records, though none have replicated the success of their 1996 hit. "Since then, Dishwala has endured a breakup and has released a series of indie records."
